plannedHeads.description: Headcount committed to this path for the shift. Must not exceed installedStations.

installedStations.description: Physical stations installed at this path.

rateUnitsPerHour.description: Service rate per head, in units/hour.

hours.description: Length of the shift in hours.

fromLocationCode.description: Optional facility-layout LocationCode enriching the committed plan with a real travel-distance hint (ADR-0017). Must be set together with toLocationCode to attempt the lookup; either omitted — or null, which is treated exactly like omitted — skips it entirely. This is a caller-opt-in enrichment, not a required field.

toLocationCode.description: Optional facility-layout LocationCode enriching the committed plan with a real travel-distance hint (ADR-0017). See fromLocationCode; null is treated exactly like omitted.
